'''LIN-34''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that operated during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], LIN-34 served [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|criminal empire]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] under Jabba's sadistic [[EV-series supervisor droid/Legends|EV-series supervisor droid]] [[EV-9D9/Legends|EV-9D9]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> BD-34 and three other droids, [[R3-B57]], [[RA-316]] and [[BD-34]], escaped [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]]. EV-9D9 thus hired a spacer to track down the droids. Jabba's enemies of the [[Ay'Nat]] pirates assigned an [[AEG-77 Vigo]] yacht and an escort of [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]] to exfiltrate LIN-34 out of the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatooine system]]. However, the yacht transporting LIN-34 was destroyed by Jabba's pilots, along with its escort.<ref name="SWG:Runaways" />

==Behind the scenes==
LIN-34 was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:Runaways" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> LIN-34 was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
